name: Lemon Velvet Ice Cream
subtitle: Taysom contribution
notes: No one has made any other lemon ice cream since Eliza and Scott’s wedding. Add raspberries if desired.

steps.title: Make the base
steps.body: Combine in a large saucepan: **2 cups sugar**, **¼ tsp salt** and **3 Tbsp flour**. Add to saucepan gradually: **3½ cups milk**.

steps.title: Thicken
steps.body: Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture thickens and bubbles. Remove from heat.

steps.title: Add the yolks
steps.body: Stir half the mixture slowly into **6 egg yolks, slightly beaten**. Stir back into remaining mixture in saucepan.

steps.title: Cool
steps.body: Remove from heat, pour into large bowl. Cool. Then stir in: **2 Tbsp grated lemon zest**, **⅔ cup lemon juice** and **3 cups heavy cream**.

steps.title: Chill and churn
steps.body: Chill, then pour into 4-6 quart ice cream freezer, and freeze according to manufacturer’s directions.

steps.title: Pack and freeze
steps.body: Pack in plastic containers; freeze until firm.
